boards.name: Rezi
boards.notes: Rezi is a resume-building product for job seekers. The employer-side Sourcing API is priced per search, message and candidate. The API docs link goes to console.rezi.ai, a subdomain of the board's own domain. No HQ, parent or language options were stated on the pages read.

sources.title: Sourcing API
sources.quote: every partner gets an engineer from our team

boards.name: WeLoveDevs
boards.notes: Employer page says a job ad can be posted free, or a subscription can be taken for access to the CV library. No API, partner program or language options were stated on the pages read.

sources.title: Employer page

boards.name: StudentJob ES
boards.notes: Page is Spanish and shows no language switcher, only links to separate country sites. Footer names YoungCapital as parent. Employers can post a job for free according to the homepage. No API or partner program details were stated.

boards.name: Cia de Talentos
boards.notes: Homepage is Portuguese. The language control shows only PT, linking to /pt/, so no other languages were confirmed. No HQ, pricing, API or partner program was stated on the pages read.

boards.name: MyVision Consulting
boards.notes: Company address is in Minato-ku, Tokyo. The site is entirely Japanese with no language selector. A fee-model statement was seen only in a fetch summary and could not be matched to a verbatim quote, so no business model is recorded.

boards.name: Textkernel
boards.notes: Vendor of recruitment AI software, not a job board. Brand reads Textkernel by Bullhorn. Language links are EN, NL, FR and DE. No HQ, pricing, API or ingest method was stated on the pages read.

boards.name: freelance.de
boards.notes: German-language platform. Employers pay a 10% service fee only on a successful engagement and can write their own project listings. No HQ, parent, API or partner program was stated on the pages read.
